title: Formal Verification in Lean
description:
This workshop will introduce software developers who are curious about formal verification to practical examples and tutorials on formal verification in Lean. It will include a short introductory lecture, followed by hands-on practical examples. Attendees can clone the lecture repo and follow along with the examples on their own machines.

Agenda:
1. What is formal verification, and what does it (not) guarantee? (5 minutes)
2. Proofs in Lean (10 minutes)
3. Formally verifying Rust (and other) code in Lean, practical examples (35 minutes)
4. Q&A (10 minutes)
